subject: Field study for ABR on the machine learning you already do
body:
Your Remote Sensing page lists machine learning modeling of vegetation and your homepage says leading edge technologies. A new client meets the homepage first and never learns you're already doing that work. The study below has a replacement paragraph already drafted for you.

https://alaskaaihq.com/awesomeproposal/abr-inc/

Worth a reply either way.

Talon at Alaska AI
opens_on: ABR's Remote Sensing page lists machine learning modeling of vegetation abundance and types while the homepage says only leading edge technologies
